package.description: An open-source Windows preview for mirroring your iPhone over AirPlay.

en-US.description: An open-source Windows preview for mirroring your iPhone over AirPlay.
en-US.longDescription:
MirrorMe receives your iPhone's screen and audio over AirPlay on your local network.
The receiver is built in; no companion iPhone app or separate receiver installation is needed.
This is an unsigned Windows x64 preview, not a Microsoft Store-certified release.
Both devices must be on the same trusted network, with private-network firewall access allowed.
Windows N/KN editions may need the Media Feature Pack. Optional HEVC requires a compatible Windows decoder.
The combined executable is distributed under GPL terms; component licenses and full corresponding source accompany the GitHub release.
en-US.name: MirrorMe
